entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with identity and pose preservation.
Asset: ONE production illustration for the framed secretary portrait in Latitude.
Image 1 is the edit target: current full-body offering pose. Preserve her exact face shape, body proportions, hairstyle silhouette, hairclip, short cape jacket, short cream skirt, tights, shoes, notebook, hand positions, blank paper card, full-body framing and canvas placement.
Image 2 is the user-approved master and the primary rendering-style reference. Image 3 is an additional reference ONLY for muted gouache/colored-pencil material treatment, never its older long-coat costume.
Repaint Image 1 in the matte, restrained hand-painted finish of Image 2 and Image 3. Warm ash-beige hair instead of pink-white, very soft broken painted hair highlights instead of sharp glossy white bands. Natural warm cream skin with subtle warm-gray shadows and visible delicate brush transitions, not smooth porcelain. Keep lively gray-green eyes and the same expression, with small restrained catchlights. Charcoal/olive cloth with subtle fine woven/pencil texture, soft diffuse shading; small muted old-brass gold details without shiny bevels or bright metallic reflections. Notebook is matte dark leather with quiet brass corners. Preserve depth, clean readable thin brown/olive linework and the character's charm; do not just lower exposure or wash the colors out. No added grain overlay or dirty face texture. The result should feel like a softly painted character in a paper illustration, not a glossy game card.
Output ONE full-body 1024x1536 PNG with actual RGBA transparency, alpha zero outside the figure. Use Image 1's existing transparent silhouette; ignore invisible RGB background colors. No backdrop, halo, paper rectangle, floor, shadows outside the character, checkerboard, text, border, UI or watermark. The head-to-waist part will be displayed inside the existing frame by CSS, so preserve Image 1's full-body scale and placement.
